messages.subject: set width and height of shiny app inside ioslides_presentation
parts:
I'm trying to use `options` to set the width and height of a shiny app. This is a simple example of my code:

---
title: "BUG"
author: "Ignacio"
date: "6/25/2015"
output: ioslides_presentation
runtime: shiny
---

## Slide with Interactive Plot

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=F}

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
  hist(
  faithful$eruptions, probability = TRUE, breaks = as.numeric(input$n_breaks),
  xlab = "Duration (minutes)", main = "Geyser eruption duration"
  )
  
  dens <- density(faithful$eruptions, adjust = input$bw_adjust)
  lines(dens, col = "blue")
  })
  
  }

ui <- fluidPage(sidebarLayout(
  sidebarPanel(
  width = 3,
  selectInput(
  "n_breaks", label = "Number of bins:",
  choices = c(10, 20, 35, 50), selected = 20
  ),
  
  sliderInput(
  "bw_adjust", label = "Bandwidth adjustment:",
  min = 0.2, max = 2, value = 1, step = 0.2
  )
  ),
  mainPanel(width = 9, plotOutput("plot"))
  ))


shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server, options = list(width=200, height=200))

```
